slides.title: Key questions

paragraphs.text: Key questions
Should Brightwork launch Dispatch Copilot in Q2 2027, and how should it be packaged and priced to lift net revenue retention from 101% to 105% by 2028 while keeping gross margin at or above 75%?
Does Copilot create enough value for customers, and enough competitive need, to launch?
How should Copilot be packaged and priced?
Does Pro reach 105% NRR, keep gross margin at or above 75%, and pay back?
Is a Q2 2027 launch worth delaying the mobile rewrite by two quarters?
How should Brightwork launch Pro and protect the mobile rewrite?
Decision maker
Success criteria
Timing
Out of scope
CEO Maya Okafor and the executive team
Net revenue retention reaches 105% by 2028, from 101% today; Company gross margin stays at or above 75%; The mobile app rewrite slips by no more than two quarters
January 2027 planning
Changing the Core plan price; Adding engineers beyond the 60 in place; Building an in-house AI model

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Launch Copilot in Q2 2027 inside a Pro tier at $12 more per seat, not as a $149 add-on
Copilot is worth launching for productivity; its retention and win-back effects are small
–	Beta accounts scheduled 11% more jobs per dispatcher-hour, against 2% for matched ones
–	AI drives only 6% of churn, and the Routewise win-back is worth at most $0.6M a year
Package it in a Pro tier at $12 more per seat, not as a $149 add-on or a free feature
–	Only 14% of offered beta accounts bought at $149, against 46% stated intent
–	Pro at 33% take-up adds about $2.9M; it beats the add-on's best case above 28%
Pro meets both financial targets if a usage allowance caps the heaviest accounts
–	NRR rises about 5 percentage points if 26% of accounts take Pro; margin holds near 76%
Launch in Q2 2027 for the NRR deadline, and hold the mobile delay to two quarters
–	Delaying mobile loses more ARR for good if the rewrite would keep over 34% of mobile churners
Test Pro on non-beta accounts in Q1 2027, launch in Q2 and manage five measures
–	Hold Pro take-up at 26% or more and margin at 75% or more; restart mobile in Q3
